item.title: "What we witnessed in terms of horrors during this war surpasses all the wars we have been through."
item.description:
"What we witnessed in terms of horrors during this war surpasses all the wars we have been through."
With these words, Dr. Ibrahim Faraj, head of the surgery department at the Lebanese Italian Hospital in Tyre, summarizes the horrors he experienced during the latest war. Faraj, who insisted on staying in south Lebanon as he did in previous wars, tells Al Araby TV about the most difficult moments when entire families arrived injured under bombardment, forcing doctors to make the hardest decision: who to save first.
He says: "In the end, you ask yourself: Who are you to decide who lives and who does not?"
